title: 第3章 拜师老律观第4章 出金
content_zh:
周围乡民瞧见这一幕，登时一片死寂，随之一片哗然。
赵半仙嘴唇嗫嚅着，脸色白了又青。
她盯着那道裂隙怅然怔神，忽地挺直佝偻的腰杆，脸上皱纹舒展，竟露出一抹近乎庄严的笑容。
“都说，天上一日，人间一年。”
她声音陡然洪亮，环视周围噤若寒蝉的乡民，郑重作揖：
“老身此去聆听仙谕，还不知要耽搁几日，人间怕是早已过去七八年，家中琐事薄产，还要烦劳诸位乡亲乡里，代为照拂一二。”
说着，又冲陈知白作揖道：“恭喜陈仙师，得仙运垂怜，老妪与有荣焉。”
说罢，她整了整那身花花绿绿的法衣，将桃木剑端端正正地捧在手中，毫不犹豫的转身踏入那道裂缝之中。
衣袂刚没入流光，裂缝便如眼睑般悄然合拢。
四下，一片死寂。
所有乡民张着嘴，瞪着眼，望着赵半仙消失的地方，如同泥塑木雕。
下意识伸手想拦的陈知白，缓缓放下手臂，面露一丝复杂，折腰作揖：
“恭送赵半仙，飞升灵界！”
声音在村口，清晰回荡。
“飞……飞升了？”
“赵半仙……成仙了？！”
人群猛地炸开了锅，惊呼声，议论声，沸反盈天。
更有甚者，眼神狂热的看向陈知白。
陈知白不敢逗留，连忙扶起父母，低声道：
“爹，娘，大姐二哥，我们回家。”

一家人浑浑噩噩，在众多复杂目光的注视下，匆匆离开十字路口。
待回到家中，关上吱呀作响的木门，李氏一把抓住陈知白，上下打量中，眼泪又落了下来：
“我儿，你实话告诉娘，那、那究竟是怎么回事？”
大姐二哥也看了过来，又是好奇，又是惊疑。
陈知白略一沉吟，将自己山中遇妖，蒙仙师搭救之事，简要说了一遍。
当然，他隐去了一些细节，又模棱两可了一些说法。
末了，又以被蛇妖夺了元气，需要修行养身为由，恳请父母允许自己离家寻仙学道。
“……娘，礼云极仙长愿引我入道门修行，还望父母答应。”
“这……”
陈父李氏面面相觑。
这晚，陈家土坯房中，油灯亮到了半夜，陈父李氏最终还是答应了陈知白。
李氏因此拉着儿子说了半宿的话。
陈知白也趁机哄着父母，服下剩下的两粒补气丹，又留下从蛇妖衣衫中搜来的碎金银。
“这些金银疙瘩，是我从妖怪洞里摸出来的，咱修行之人吃住都在山里用不到，就留给爹娘买几亩水田养老。他日我若学道归来，也算有个栖身之所。”
油灯毕剥，光影灼灼。
李氏看着那黄白相间的碎金银，粗糙老手颤了颤，终是没有细问，只长长叹了口气。
陈知白身上还有一些珠宝首饰，本想一并留下，念头一转，还是算了。
这些珠宝首饰，还不知是蛇妖从哪里掠来，终究不祥，还是莫要节外生枝。
content_en:
When the surrounding villagers saw this scene, there was a sudden silence, and then there was an uproar.
Zhao Banxian pursed his lips and turned pale and green.
She stared at the crack in a daze, then suddenly straightened her stooped waist, and the wrinkles on her face relaxed, revealing an almost solemn smile.
"It is said that a day in heaven is like a year on earth."
Her voice suddenly became loud and clear. She looked around at the silent villagers and bowed solemnly:
"I am here to listen to the immortal edict. I don't know how many days I will be delayed. I am afraid that seven or eight years have passed in the world. I have trivial matters at home and my income is low. I have to trouble all the fellow villagers to take care of me on my behalf."
After saying that, he bowed to Chen Zhibai and said: "Congratulations to Master Chen, you have received the mercy of immortal luck. This old woman is so honored."
After that, she straightened her colorful robes, held the mahogany sword upright in her hands, and turned around and stepped into the crack without hesitation.
As soon as the clothes were submerged in the flowing light, the cracks closed quietly like eyelids.
All around, there was dead silence.
All the villagers opened their mouths and stared at the place where Zhao Banxian disappeared, like clay and wood sculptures.
Chen Zhibai, who subconsciously reached out to stop him, slowly lowered his arm, with a complicated expression on his face, and bowed:
"Congratulations to Zhao Banxian for his ascension to the spiritual world!"
The voice echoed clearly at the entrance of the village.
"Fly...ascend?"
"Zhao Banxian...has become an immortal?!"
The crowd suddenly exploded, with screams and comments filling the sky.
What's more, he looked at Chen Zhibai with feverish eyes.
Chen Zhibai didn't dare to stay, so he quickly helped his parents up and whispered:
"Father, mother, eldest sister and second brother, let's go home."
The family was confused and hurriedly left the intersection under the gaze of many complicated eyes.
After returning home and closing the creaking wooden door, Li grabbed Chen Zhibai and looked him up and down, tears falling again:
"My son, tell mother the truth, then, what exactly happened?"
The eldest sister and the second brother also looked over, curious and surprised.
Chen Zhibai pondered for a moment and briefly told the story of how he met a demon in the mountains and was rescued by an immortal master.
Of course, he concealed some details and made some ambiguities.
Finally, he begged his parents to allow him to leave home to seek immortality and learn Taoism on the grounds that he had been deprived of his vitality by the snake demon and needed to practice cultivation.
"...Mom, Liyun Jixian has always wanted to introduce me to Taoism and practice. I hope my parents will agree."
"This..."
Chen's father and Mrs. Li looked at each other in confusion.
That night, in the Chen family's adobe house, the oil lamp was on until midnight. Chen's father, Mrs. Li, finally agreed to Chen Zhibai.
Therefore, Mrs. Li held her son and talked for a long time.
Chen Zhibai also took the opportunity to coax his parents into taking the remaining two Qi-Building Pills, and left behind the broken gold and silver found in the snake demon's clothes.
"I got these gold and silver lumps out of the monster cave. We cultivators don't have enough food and accommodation in the mountains, so I left it to my parents to buy a few acres of paddy fields for our retirement. If I come back from studying Taoism in the future, I can have a roof over my head."
The oil lamp is peeled off, and the light and shadow are scorching.
Li looked at the yellow and white broken gold and silver, her rough old hands trembled, but in the end she didn't ask in detail, she just let out a long sigh.
Chen Zhibai still had some jewelry on him, and he wanted to keep them all, but then he changed his mind and decided not to.
I don’t know where the snake demon snatched these jewelry pieces from. After all, it’s ominous, so it’s better not to cause trouble.
